definitions.explanation: A person of higher rank or position in an organization, especially at work.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}に{相談|そうだん}した。
{上司|じょうし}と{部下|ぶか}の{関係|かんけい}は{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The relationship between superiors and subordinates is difficult.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}から{指示|しじ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received instructions from my supervisor.

notes:
{上司|じょうし} is commonly used in workplace contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直属|ちょくぞく}の{上司|じょうし} (direct supervisor)
- {上司|じょうし}と{部下|ぶか} (superiors and subordinates)
- {上司|じょうし}の{許可|きょか} (boss's permission)
- {上司|じょうし}に{報告|ほうこく}する (to report to one's superior)

COMPARISON:
- {上司|じょうし}: superior (work hierarchy)
- {部下|ぶか}: subordinate (opposite of 上司)
- ボス: boss (casual, from English)
- {社長|しゃちょう}: company president
